testsuite.name: gspa.integration.ConvergenceLoopSpec

testcase.name: empty priorEngine yields a single-pass refinement
a single prior contribution propagates into the posterior
refiner converges when priors are stationary
damping prevents oscillation when a non-monotone prior flips sign
final posterior probability reflects log-odds sigmoid
